title: Vehicle features and dealer ability
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on what owners can or cannot do with vehicle features and app functions, alongside whether dealers are able to diagnose, supply, or complete repairs.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise convenient voice commands and quick access to information such as vehicle range.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on dealers being unable to diagnose problems promptly or complete repairs within the expected timeframe.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a wide mix of abilities, limitations, and feature requests such as app controls, phone contacts, parts availability, and routine vehicle use without giving clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits how specifically the overall tone can be characterized.
This topic mixes unrelated subjects including feature usefulness, unmet feature requests, connectivity setup, parts fitment, and dealer repair status.
Some examples describe another brand or provide too little context to determine a clear sentiment for the broader topic.
